versions.changelog:
**Major update: Adds direct Chrome ("user" profile) browser control for OpenClaw 3.13+ and details new setup.**

- Added full support for OpenClaw versions >= v3.13 using direct Chrome attachment (profile: "user"); no relay extension needed.
- Provided step-by-step setup instructions for enabling Chrome remote debugging.
- Included profile auto-detection code for backward compatibility with older OpenClaw versions.
- Retained legacy Chrome relay extension guidance for users on older setups.
- Expanded troubleshooting and prerequisites sections for easier onboarding.

- Added "Browser" to the list of allowed tools, enabling usage of the Browser tool directly.
- Introduced a simple, reliable DeepSeek response extraction function and provided guidance to always use this method for extracting responses from the page.
- Updated documentation to highlight and explain the new recommended extraction method for agents, enhancing consistency and reliability.
- No functional code changes outside documentation and metadata.

freechat-deepseek v1.0.2 changelog

- Updated documentation to clarify and expand the step-by-step workflow for DeepSeek Chat login and automation.
- Added explicit multi-channel QR code delivery logic and instructions (iMessage, WhatsApp, QQBot, etc.).
- Improved login timeout and retry guidance for more robust QR-based authentication.
- Adjusted workflow to six distinct steps, detailing each phase from login to reply extraction.
- Enhanced requirements and use case descriptions for clear user guidance.

- Skill name changed from "chat-deepseek" to "freechat-deepseek".
- "chat-deepseek" added to the alias list for backwards compatibility.
- No other functional or documentation changes detected in this version.
